title: SkillScriptBench: Benchmarking Self-Evolution of Executable Agent Skill Packages Beyond Markdown
abstract: arXiv:2610.04008v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Executable Agent Skills combine natural-language instructions and scripts into reusable packages for LLM agents, and revising them requires fixing errors without breaking correct behavior. Existing benchmarks do not systematically distinguish documentation repair, script repair, and preservation when evaluating skill self-evolution. We introduce SkillScriptBench, a 350-task benchmark designed to evaluate these capabilities separately. From a survey of over 35,000 GitHub-hosted Skill roots, we select 100 packages and construct 150 repair tasks. Each task pairs a package containing injected script faults with a maintenance request and executable checks of the required behavior. A complementary controlled track contains 200 tasks from 50 packages, each evaluated under the same maintenance request in four states: clean, documentation faults, script faults, and faults in both. translated_title: SkillScriptBench：超越 Markdown 的可执行智能体技能包自我演化基准测试
translated_abstract: 可执行智能体技能将自然语言指令与脚本组合成可复用的包，供大语言模型（LLM）智能体使用；对这些技能包进行修订时，需要在修复错误的同时不破坏已有的正确行为。现有基准在评估技能自我演化时，未能系统地区分文档修复、脚本修复与行为保持这三种能力。我们提出 SkillScriptBench，一个包含 350 个任务、旨在分别评估这些能力的基准。通过对超过 35,000 个托管在 GitHub 上的 Skill 根目录的调查，我们选取了 100 个技能包并构建了 150 个修复任务。每个任务将一个注入了脚本缺陷的技能包与一条维护请求以及对所需行为的可执行检查配对。一个补充性的受控赛道包含来自 50 个技能包的 200 个任务，每个任务在相同的维护请求下于四种状态中分别评估：无缺陷、仅文档缺陷、仅脚本缺陷、以及文档与脚本同时存在缺陷。在四个大语言模型上的实验表明，同时编辑文档与脚本的方法……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 SkillScriptBench——一个包含 350 个任务的基准，首次将可执行智能体技能包自我演化中的文档修复、脚本修复与正确行为保持三类能力系统性地分离开来评估。
en_tdlr: SkillScriptBench is a 350-task benchmark that systematically separates documentation repair, script repair, and behavior preservation when evaluating the self-evolution of executable agent skill packages.
